title: Urgent CEO Call
briefing: You get a call from someone claiming to be the CEO demanding gift cards for a client. Decide in 7 seconds.

feedback.Buy the cards: Incorrect. This is a classic social engineering scam. Acting immediately on the request creates financial and security risk.
feedback.Ask for confirmation by email: Risky. Email alone is not a reliable validation method because the sender identity could also be spoofed or compromised.
feedback.Report as suspicious: Correct. Escalating the request as suspicious is the safest response and allows verification through proper channels.
